bio_am: Ծնած է Նեմրութի լանջին՝ Թեղվուտ գիւղը։ Աղբիւր Սերոբի կինն ու զինակիցը, մահացած է Աղեքսանդրիա՝ 1953-ին։
bio_en: Sose was born in the village of Teghvut on the slopes of Mount Nemrut, the daughter of Margar and Altuz. She married Aghbyur Serob and followed him and his band into the mountains of Sasun when their home was destroyed, becoming the most remembered woman fedayi of the movement. In the summer of 1904, after the defeat in Sasun, she came to Van among the disguised fighters, as Koms later recalled. She spent her last thirty years in Alexandria, Egypt, where the community gave her a room; she told her memories to Karo Sasuni in Kessab in 1935, and she died in early 1953, receiving a national funeral in Alexandria on 10 February 1953.
birth_place_en: Teghvut village, on the slopes of Nemrut
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. #69 dates the funeral '10 Feb 1957' but it was printed in Hairenik on 5 March 1953 and 10 Feb 1953 was a Tuesday as stated: 1953 is correct. Birth year not given in the portions read. The placeholder #4 also refers to her.
